plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (mapper app https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Map: 'Human Resource Management map for 2026-2027'; program page states 'Catalog 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This is the program's only pathway. The map prints the degree total as a range, 60-62.5 units, Term 1 as 15-16.5 units and Term 2 as 15-16 units. Two slots print ranges: the Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' choice slot (3-4.5 units) and the Term 2 '1.B. Oral Communication and Critical Thinking (BC)' choice slot (3-4 units). Per the standing minimum-credit convention they are recorded at 3 each, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum (15 / 15 / 15 / 15) and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. All other slots print single unit values; the Term 3 'BC Elective' slot prints at 2 units (the Term 1 and Term 2 BC Elective slots print at 3), recorded as printed. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites' flag (searched; none present), so no prereqs are recorded. Semester milestone headings printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. Data-quality disclosure: during the 2026-11-15 capture session the mapper served two different versions of its choice-dropdown option data for the same map URLs (an earlier rendering with previous-catalog course numbers/titles, then the current 2026-2027 rendering, confirmed on two consecutive reloads of each map). Degree totals, term totals, major-course rows and slot headings were identical in both renderings; only dropdown option codes/titles differed. Per the Wave100 convention, the option lists behind general-education and elective slots are not enumerated in this seed, so that variation affects no recorded course, code or credit in this plan. The map states it represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements, and advises students to make an appointment to create a customized education plan.
